Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我想出去走走……
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I think I need some fresh air…

OptionText.LocalizedString: Would you like me to come along?

Content.SourceString: 走吧，我有空。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's go, I'm free.

Content.SourceString: 需要我一起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Would you like me to come along?

Content.SourceString: 嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 所以准备去哪里呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So where are we planning to go?

Content.SourceString: 想去附近那家「月亮湾」看看。
Content.LocalizedString: I was thinking we could check out that Luna Bay place nearby.

Content.SourceString: 好。那我们在店门口见。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay. Let's meet at the entrance then.

Content.SourceString: 好。那我们在店门口见。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay. Let's meet at the entrance then.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，要看电影吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, would you like to watch a movie?

Content.SourceString: 好啊。什么电影？
Content.LocalizedString: Sure thing. What movie?

Content.SourceString: 《夏日的晴空》。
Content.LocalizedString: "Clear Skies in Summer".

Content.SourceString: 听起来还不错。
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds pretty good.

Content.SourceString: 有种微妙的反差感……没想到你会喜欢这样的电影。
Content.LocalizedString: There's an interesting contrast… I wouldn't have expected you to like this kind of movie.

Content.SourceString: 诶？在鉴定师的印象里，我会喜欢什么样的电影？
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? What kind of movies do you think I'd like, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 大概是《侦探问道》那样的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Probably something like "Case in Point", I guess.

Content.SourceString: 这个嘛……其实我早就已经把《侦探问道》全系列看过几遍了。
Content.LocalizedString: Well… actually, I've already watched the entire "Case in Point" series several times.

Content.SourceString: 果然……
Content.LocalizedString: I see…

Content.SourceString: 那，鉴定师愿意来的话，我们就在伊波恩二楼见吧。
Content.LocalizedString: So, if the Appraiser is willing to come, let's meet on the second floor of Eibon.

Content.SourceString: 我先去调试一下设备……
Content.LocalizedString: I'll go set up the equipment first…

Content.SourceString: 好。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay.

Content.SourceString: 好。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay.

Content.SourceString: 听到「碎雪」冰淇淋车的广告歌声吗？一定有辆刚从伊波恩门前路过。
Content.LocalizedString: Do you hear that ice cream cart jingle? One must have just passed by Eibon.

OptionText.LocalizedString: So that's the ice cream jingle.

Content.SourceString: 听到广告声就想吃了。
Content.LocalizedString: Hearing that jingle makes me want some ice cream.

Content.SourceString: 刚刚的动静原来是「碎雪」的广告声吗？这下记住了。
Content.LocalizedString: So that sound just now was the ice cream cart jingle? I'll remember that now.

Content.SourceString: 「碎雪」也是塔吉多的最爱，他每次听到都会追着跑出去。
Content.LocalizedString: Blizzi is Taygedo's favorite. Every time he hears it, he runs out chasing after it.

Content.SourceString: 简单明快的旋律却让人记忆非常深刻……
Content.LocalizedString: Simple, catchy, memorable…

Content.SourceString: 但有时候出发得太急会忘记带钱包……又垂头丧气走回来。
Content.LocalizedString: But sometimes he rushes out so fast that he forgets his wallet… and then comes back all dejected.

Content.SourceString: 可能也是因为哪怕仅仅只是听到它，舌尖就会浮现冰淇淋的滋味吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe it's because just hearing it makes you taste ice cream on your tongue.

Content.SourceString: 不过……真正的「碎雪」的味道……会是什么样的呢？
Content.LocalizedString: But… what would a real Blizzi ice cream taste like, I wonder?

Content.SourceString: 真正的「碎雪」？
Content.LocalizedString: Real Blizzi?

Content.SourceString: 啊……那个……并不是说现在的「碎雪」是盗版的意思。
Content.LocalizedString: Ah… um… I don't mean that the Blizzi now is a fake or anything.

Content.SourceString: 这个故事是爸爸讲给我听的，在爸爸也还是小孩子的时候……
Content.LocalizedString: My father told me this story when he was still a child himself…

Content.SourceString: 公园附近总是停着一辆叫「碎雪」的异象冰淇淋车，她总是亲切招呼着孩子们尝尝看她的新口味冰淇淋，最喜欢的是孩子们品尝冰淇淋时满足的笑容。
Content.LocalizedString: There was always an anomaly ice cream cart called Blizzi parked near the park. She would always greet the kids warmly and invite them to try her new ice cream flavors, and what she loved most were the satisfied smiles on their faces when they tasted her ice cream.

Content.SourceString: 每当「碎雪」唱起歌来，高高荡着秋千，快荡到天际的孩子们都会团聚过来买冰淇淋。
Content.LocalizedString: Whenever Blizzi would start singing, all the kids around the place would drop everything at once for an ice cream.

Content.SourceString: 在稍远一点的地方守候着的是她的哥哥「向阳」，不过「向阳」是热狗车。他总是沉默寡言，不会夸耀自己招揽客人，也不太擅长微笑……
Content.LocalizedString: Waiting a little further away was her older brother Sunni, though Sunni was a hot dog cart. He was always quiet and reserved, never boasting to attract customers, and wasn't very good at smiling…

Content.SourceString: 肚子饿到咕咕叫的孩子们排队买热狗，嘴馋的孩子们排队买「碎雪」冰淇淋……据说最受欢迎的热狗是挤满番茄酱和黄芥末酱的，最好吃的冰淇淋是香草味的。
Content.LocalizedString: Kids with rumbling stomachs would line up to buy hot dogs, while kids with sweet cravings would line up to buy ice cream… They say the most popular hot dog was loaded with ketchup and mustard, and the best ice cream was vanilla.

Content.SourceString: 不过突然有一天，孩子们发现「碎雪」和「向阳」都不停在那里了。他们发动起来，向很远很远的地方开去……
Content.LocalizedString: But suddenly one day, the kids discovered that both Blizzi and Sunni had stopped coming there. They drove off to somewhere far, far away…

Content.SourceString: 据说是喜欢小孩子的妹妹「碎雪」听到了远方传来的孩子们的欢笑声，决定也为那里的孩子们送去冰淇淋……
Content.LocalizedString: They say that Blizzi heard the joyful laughter of kids coming from far away and decided to bring ice cream to them…

Content.SourceString: 他们离开了那个公园……现在可能早就离开海特洛市了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: They left that park… They've probably left Hethereau altogether by now, haven't they?

Content.SourceString: 有一位大叔——也就是现在经营「碎雪」冰淇淋的人不忍心看到公园的孩子们吃不到最喜欢的冰淇淋，于是也开着冰淇淋车在附近做起生意来。
Content.LocalizedString: There was a man who now runs the "Blizzi" ice cream business who couldn't bear to see the kids in the park go without their favorite ice cream, so he also started driving an ice cream cart around the area to do business.

Content.SourceString: 可能是因为距离很近，而被误认为那就是「碎雪」冰淇淋……大叔怎么解释都说服不了大家的样子，最后就不再争辩什么了。
Content.LocalizedString: Probably because he was so close by, people mistook him for the real Blizzi… No matter how the man tried to explain, he couldn't seem to convince anyone, so in the end he just stopped arguing about it.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此……
Content.LocalizedString: I see…

Content.SourceString: 所以在时间过去了这么久后的现在，大家说到的「碎雪」就是「碎雪」冰淇淋，不再是那个亲切可爱的异象冰淇淋车呢。
Content.LocalizedString: So now, after all this time has passed, when people mention Blizzi, they're talking about "Blizzi," not that sweet and lovable anomaly ice cream cart anymore.

Content.SourceString: 有机会真想见一面……
Content.LocalizedString: I'd really love to meet them someday if I had the chance…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师能听懂异象们说的话，那一定也明白纳库佩达的意思吧？
Content.LocalizedString: If you can understand what anomalies are saying, you must also understand what Nacupeda says, right?

Content.SourceString: 提醒我一下，纳库佩达是……？
Content.LocalizedString: What is Nacupeda again…?

Content.SourceString: 海特洛市最受欢迎的人气异象，它住在纳库佩达公园的许愿池里。
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau's most popular and beloved anomaly. It lives in the wishing pool at Nacupeda Park.

Content.SourceString: 这么说好像不太准确……那个公园是在纳库佩达定居后才改名「纳库佩达公园」来着。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, that's not quite accurate… The park was only renamed Nacupeda Park after Nacupeda settled there.

Content.SourceString: 听说向纳库佩达虔诚许愿、掷下硬币就能获得它的赐福。
Content.LocalizedString: People say if you make a sincere wish to Nacupeda and throw in a coin, you'll receive its blessing.

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达会在晚上游人稀少的时候咀嚼硬币，同时发出「嗯！」的声音。
Content.LocalizedString: Nacupeda chews on the coins at night when there aren't many visitors around, and it makes this "Mhm!" sound while doing it.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉观察真仔细。
Content.LocalizedString: You're really observant, Edgar.

Content.SourceString: 嗯。我一直有写观察日记……
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm. I've been keeping observation journals…

Content.SourceString: ……我刚刚不是在学纳库佩达说话！
Content.LocalizedString: …I wasn't trying to imitate how Nacupeda talks just now!

Content.SourceString: 总之，纳库佩达的「嗯！」究竟是什么意思呢？很想请教一下鉴定师……
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, what does Nacupeda's "Mhm!" actually mean? I'd really like to know about it…

Content.SourceString: 请看看这个！是我拍的纳库佩达的进食……呃……吃饭？视频。
Content.LocalizedString: Please take a look at this! It's a video I took of Nacupeda feeding… uh… eating?

Content.SourceString: <blue>纳库佩达咀嚼硬币.mp4</>
Content.LocalizedString: <blue>nacupeda-chewing-coin.mp4</>

Content.SourceString: 它好像只是在单纯地「嗯！」而已。
Content.LocalizedString: It looks like it's just going "Mhm!" and that's it.

Content.SourceString: 欸？纳库佩达原来没有在说话吗？如果并没是在表达什么的话……
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? So Nacupeda wasn't actually talking? If it's not trying to express anything, then…

Content.SourceString: 最近会什么会「变声」发出「奥！」的声音呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Why would it recently change its voice to make "Ow!" sounds instead?

Content.SourceString: 这是我昨晚拍的视频，它这样变声已经有两天了。
Content.LocalizedString: This is the video I took last night. It's been changing its voice like this for two days now.

Content.SourceString: <blue>纳库佩达咀嚼硬币·新.mp4</>
Content.LocalizedString: <blue>nacupeda-chewing-coin-new.mp4</>

Content.SourceString: 它只是「奥！」了一下而已。
Content.LocalizedString: It just goes "Ow!" once, that's all.

Content.SourceString: 好奇怪，为什么会突然变声呢？明明环境条件都没有变……
Content.LocalizedString: That's so strange. Why would it suddenly change its voice? The environmental conditions clearly haven't changed at all…

Content.SourceString: 啊，会不会是因为这个？纳库佩达吃的「硬币」……并不是真的硬币，而是金币形状的曲奇饼干。
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, could it be because of this? The coins that Nacupeda has been eating… aren't real coins, but gold coin-shaped cookies.

Content.SourceString: 我搜搜看……金币饼干是最近热门畅销的人气新品，所以很多人会拿它投喂纳库佩达……
Content.LocalizedString: Let me search this up… Gold coin cookies are a popular new trending product that's been selling really well lately, so lots of people have been feeding them to Nacupeda…

Content.SourceString: 原来纳库佩达的「奥！」是对金币饼干的欺诈有声的控诉。
Content.LocalizedString: So Nacupeda's "Ow!" sounds are actually vocal protests against the gold coin cookie scam.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师……现在已经完全适应海特洛的生活了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser… How are you doing in Hethereau by now?

Content.SourceString: 完全没问题，我很喜欢这里的生活。
Content.LocalizedString: No problem at all! I really love living here.

Content.SourceString: 循序渐进，我还在探索这座城市。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm taking it slow. Let things happen and let myself explore around.

Content.SourceString: 那真是太好了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm glad to hear that.

Content.SourceString: 需要帮忙的话，可以联系我，我会尽可能帮忙的。
Content.LocalizedString: If you need any help, you can find me. I'll do whatever I can to help.

Content.SourceString: 之前听店长说过，鉴定师……似乎不是很清楚自己过去的经历。
Content.LocalizedString: I heard Hotori mention before that you don't seem to remember much about your past.

Content.SourceString: 我的「记忆」，从新西里安市的「极漩」灾难开始。
Content.LocalizedString: My memories start from the Hypervortex incident in New Helios.

Content.SourceString: 在那之前的「过去」还在寻找中。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm still searching for my past before that.

Content.SourceString: 那鉴定师……多少会为自己空白的记忆感到困扰吧？
Content.LocalizedString: …You must feel somewhat troubled by those blank memories, right?

Content.SourceString: 的确多多少少会有一些。
Content.LocalizedString: More or less, I suppose.

Content.SourceString: 尝试过很多方法试图想起来些什么。
Content.LocalizedString: I've tried a lot of different methods to remember something.

Content.SourceString: 偶尔会感到不知所措，或者是困惑。
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes I feel lost, or confused.

Content.SourceString: 但几乎毫无进展——为此感到非常苦恼。
Content.LocalizedString: But I've made almost no progress at all, which is really troubling.

Content.SourceString: 那个……我检索了一些拥有致人失忆能力的异象，但是都没有在新西里安市存在这种异象的情报。
Content.LocalizedString: Um… I searched for anomalies that can cause memory loss, but there's no intel on any such anomalies existing in New Helios.

Content.SourceString: 当然也可能是我的异能……并不像塔吉多他们想象中那么厉害，能查阅到的资料其实很有限。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, it's also possible that my Esper isn't as powerful as Taygedo and the others think it is, so the information I can access is actually quite limited.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有没有设想过……失去记忆是鉴定师获得异能的代价？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you ever considered… that losing your memory might be the price you paid for your Esper?

Content.SourceString: 那样的话，很难有找回的可能性吧？甚至完全没有？
Content.LocalizedString: In that case, it would be really hard to get them back, wouldn't it? Or maybe even impossible?

Content.SourceString: 是的……想获得些什么，就注定会失去什么……这就是获得异能的「代价」。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes… if you want to gain something, you're destined to lose something else… All Espers have to pay a price.

Content.SourceString: 考虑到这一点，稍微转化思路的话……鉴定师再为自己的记忆伤脑筋的时候，是否会轻松一些呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Considering that, if you change your perspective a little… maybe it will be easier for you when you're worrying about your memories, Appraiser?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Since you put it that way…

Content.SourceString: 既然旧的记忆已经无法取回，不如专注当下创造新的美好记忆？
Content.LocalizedString: "Since I can't get my old memories back anyway, why not focus on the present and create new wonderful memories instead?"

Content.SourceString: 那个……我是说……可能有一定的可能性……当然鉴定师更可能很快就能想起过去了！
Content.LocalizedString: Um… I mean… I'm just saying maybe… But yeah… or maybe you might just remember your past someday!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，埃德嘉。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Edgar.

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯……找回记忆的事……我也会尽可能帮忙的……
Content.LocalizedString: Um… about getting your memories back… I'll help as much as I can too…

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多刚刚在呗果上和我说，他觉得我在呗果聊天的时候好像话多了一些……
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo just told me on Bagel that he thinks I seem to talk a bit more when I'm chatting on Bagel…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师也觉得……是这样吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you think so too, Appraiser… is that really the case?

Content.SourceString: 确实如此，塔吉多观察力很敏锐！
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed. Taygedo is quite observative.

Content.SourceString: 真相是——埃德嘉其实很健谈！
Content.LocalizedString: The truth is… Edgar is actually quite chatty!

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯，更加佩服塔吉多了呢。毕竟我自己都没有注意到他所说的变化……
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, I admire Taygedo even more now. After all, I didn't even notice the differences he mentioned myself…

Content.SourceString: 谢谢。虽说我觉得还算不上健谈……
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you. Though I don't really think I'm that chatty…

Content.SourceString: 这样算逐渐能够「畅所欲言」吗？好像在呗果上，的确是这样……
Content.LocalizedString: Does this count as gradually being able to speak my mind? It seems like at Bagel, that really is the case…

Content.SourceString: 但现实中要多多开口说话，还没法这么顺利……
Content.LocalizedString: But speaking up more in real life… I can't do that as smoothly yet…

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉很擅长通过「呗果」来表达？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you good at expressing yourself on Bagel?

Content.SourceString: 我想想……也许不止是我，和塔吉多在呗果上聊天的时候，我也更容易理解他的意思。
Content.LocalizedString: Let me think… Maybe it's not just me. When I chat with Taygedo on Bagel, I find it easier to understand what he means too.

Content.SourceString: 可能是「呗果」为我们创造了更……「畅所欲言」的空间？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe Bagel creates a more… open space for us to express ourselves?

Content.SourceString: 比如塔吉多的想法，可以用文字准确、快速地传递到屏幕的这一边。
Content.LocalizedString: For example, Taygedo's thoughts can be transmitted accurately and quickly through text to this side of the screen.

Content.SourceString: 如果与塔吉多面对面聊天就要连蒙带猜了。
Content.LocalizedString: If you were chatting with Taygedo face to face, you'd have to guess what he means half the time.

Content.SourceString: 是啊，有时候理解他的话不够准确，还会误解他的意思。0△0
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, sometimes I don't understand what he's saying accurately enough, and I end up misinterpreting what he means.O.O

Content.SourceString: 那埃德嘉呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What about Edgar?

Content.SourceString: 我……我吗？我总是在听大家说话，在理解大家的想法和目标……
Content.LocalizedString: Me…? I'm always listening to everyone talk, trying to understand everyone's thoughts and goals…

Content.SourceString: 似乎……很少有我「自己」的想法，不知道该怎么接话……
Content.LocalizedString: It seems like… I rarely have my own thoughts, and I don't know how to respond in conversations…

Content.SourceString: 有时候说得太慢吞吞，也会麻烦大家。
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes when I speak too slowly, it causes trouble for everyone.

Content.SourceString: 在呗果上，好像就能把自己的想法整理好，用文字好好表达出来了……
Content.LocalizedString: On Bagel, it seems like I can organize my thoughts properly and express them well through text…

Content.SourceString: 不过在现实中，我会更加努力和大家更顺畅地沟通的。
Content.LocalizedString: But in real life, I'll work harder to communicate more smoothly with everyone.

Content.SourceString: 我喜欢听到大家的声音，喜欢看到大家笑起来幸福的样子……
Content.LocalizedString: I like hearing everyone's voices, and I like seeing how happy everyone looks when they smile…

Content.SourceString: 谢谢鉴定师帮忙带来我的会员卡！
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for helping me get my membership card, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 举手之劳，不用再特地道谢。
Content.LocalizedString: It was nothing, really. No need to thank me again.

Content.SourceString: 小事一桩，帮上忙就好。
Content.LocalizedString: It's no big deal, glad I could help.

Content.SourceString: 劳烦鉴定师跑腿真的非常不好意思。0△0
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really sorry for making you run around like that, Appraiser.O.O

Content.SourceString: 我把「检查口袋里的会员卡」写在了备忘录上，以后出门前先读一遍备忘录。这样就不会再麻烦鉴定师跑一趟了。
Content.LocalizedString: I wrote "check for membership card in pocket" on my memo pad. From now on, I'll read through my memos before leaving the house. That way I won't have to trouble you to make another trip, Appraiser.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Running errands is fine with me.

Content.SourceString: 朋友之间互帮互助不是很正常吗？多跑跑腿也没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: Isn't it normal for friends to help each other out? I really don't mind running a few errands.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉做事非常独立呢，不过偶尔向朋友求助也没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar, you're really independent with everything you do. But it's totally fine to ask friends for help once in a while too.

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯……主要是，想到可能会打扰鉴定师原来的安排……
Content.LocalizedString: Well… it's mainly that I was thinking I might be disrupting your original plans, Appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 就觉得：果然还是不要麻烦对方会比较好。
Content.LocalizedString: I just think it's better not to trouble you after all.

Content.SourceString: 不麻烦不麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString: It's no trouble at all, really.

Content.SourceString: 好的，鉴定师的话……我会考虑看看的。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, if you say so, Appraiser… I'll think about it.

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉之前也总是这么说……「家族成员就该彼此依赖！」
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally always used to say the same thing… "Family members should rely on each other!"

Content.SourceString: 就是就是，这就是柯林斯家族的羁绊！
Content.LocalizedString: Exactly, exactly! That's the bond of The Coluccis!

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉说得对！建议收录至柯林斯「家族信条」。
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally's right! I suggest we add that to The Coluccis' family creed.

Content.SourceString: 好……好的。如果有机会的话，我会试试看……
Content.LocalizedString: O… okay. If the opportunity comes up, I'll give it a try…

Content.SourceString: 然后，在那之后，务必要让我请鉴定师吃冰淇淋>.<
Content.LocalizedString: And after that, you have to let me treat you to ice cream, Appraiser!>_<

Content.SourceString: 不对不对，首先是……为了答谢鉴定师今天帮我带来会员卡，让我请你吃冰淇淋>.<！
Content.LocalizedString: No no, first of all… to thank you for helping me bring the membership card today, let me treat you to ice cream, Appraiser!>_<

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师你好，我是埃德嘉。异象猎人相关的工作，我会努力帮忙的。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello, Appraiser. I'm Edgar. I'll do my best to help with anything related to Anomaly Hunter work.

Content.SourceString: 准确说希望能帮上忙……尽量不拖后腿？毕竟我不像娜娜莉早雾一样擅长战斗……
Content.LocalizedString: To be precise, I hope I can be helpful… and try not to hold everyone back? After all, I'm not good at combat like Nanally and Sakiri are…
O.O

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉才不会拖后腿。
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar would never hold anyone back.

Content.SourceString: 战斗的事情就交给我们吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Leave the fighting to us!

Content.SourceString: 让我们彼此分工、团结协作吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's divide up the work and collaborate as a team.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉的信息支援也非常重要。
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar's info support is really important too.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 好，好的。我会继续努力……
Content.LocalizedString: O-okay. I'll keep doing my best…

Content.SourceString: 那……以后就请鉴定师多多指教！
Content.LocalizedString: Then… please guide me well, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 尤其是关于异象的事，我可能会请教很多……
Content.LocalizedString: Especially about anomalies… I might have a lot of questions…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有着敏锐的异象感知力，读得懂它们想说的话……真好啊。
Content.LocalizedString: The Appraiser has such sharp Anomaly Perception, able to understand what they're trying to say… That's amazing.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉很喜欢异象？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you really like anomalies, Edgar?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……非常喜欢。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes… I really do.

Content.SourceString: 想了解更多有关异象的事，所以来到了伊波恩……和大家成为了好朋友。
Content.LocalizedString: I wanted to learn more about anomalies, so I came to Eibon… and became good friends with everyone.

Content.SourceString: 未来也希望也能和鉴定师成为好朋友。>.<
Content.LocalizedString: I hope we can become good friends too, Appraiser.>_<

Content.SourceString: 当然，一定会的。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, I'm sure we will.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多很喜欢娜娜莉和早雾给他化的妆呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo really likes the makeup that Nanally and Sakiri do for him.

Content.SourceString: 他给我分享了好多不同角度的自拍，让我帮忙评价评价，选出最好看的一张。
Content.LocalizedString: He shared lots of selfies from different angles with me and asked me to help evaluate them and pick out the best looking one.

Content.SourceString: 不知道我选的那张他满不满意……
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder if he was satisfied with the one I picked…

Content.SourceString: 放心，他肯定满意。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, he's definitely satisfied.

Content.SourceString: 呼……有鉴定师这么说，那应该就没问题了。
Content.LocalizedString: Phew… If you say so, Appraiser, then it should be fine.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉有什么顾虑吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is something troubling you, Edgar?

Content.SourceString: 单纯是因为，我……是埃德嘉，我不是塔吉多？也不是……大家？
Content.LocalizedString: It's simply because… I'm Edgar, I'm not Taygedo? And I'm not… everyone else?

Content.SourceString: 也许我选的那张在大家看来并不是最好看的一张，塔吉多可能会难过……
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe the one I picked isn't actually the best looking one in everyone else's opinion, and Taygedo might be upset…

Content.SourceString: 这样就辜负了塔吉多的信赖……
Content.LocalizedString: That would mean I've let Taygedo down…

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多希望你帮他出主意，这说明塔吉多在乎的是埃德嘉的选择而非「大家」的选择吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo asked you to help him decide, which means he cares about Edgar's choice, not everyone else's, right?

Content.SourceString: 不然塔吉多就会在伊波恩的群聊相册里上传照片，叫来我们投票选选看。
Content.LocalizedString: Otherwise, Taygedo would just upload the photos to Eibon's group chat album and ask all of us to vote on them.

Content.SourceString: 唔，鉴定师的话好有道理……
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm, what you're saying makes a lot of sense, Appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 或者你可以直接问问看塔吉多是怎么想的。
Content.LocalizedString: Or you could just ask Taygedo directly what he thinks.

Content.SourceString: 与其自己思考种种可能性，不妨直接了解对方的意见吗？我试试看……
Content.LocalizedString: Rather than thinking through all the possibilities myself, why not just find out what he thinks directly? I'll give it a try…

Content.SourceString: 以及问问看塔吉多为什么会找我呢？或许是他对我的评价有所期待……
Content.LocalizedString: And I should ask why Taygedo came to me in the first place, right? Maybe he actually has high expectations for my judgment…

Content.SourceString: 鼓励.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: encouraging.jpg

Content.SourceString: 欸？塔吉多说……
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? Taygedo said…

Content.SourceString: 因为我的聊天框最靠前，他就顺手发给我了。
Content.LocalizedString: Because my chat window was at the top of his list, he just sent it to me out of convenience.

Content.SourceString: 不愧是塔吉多。
Content.LocalizedString: That's just like Taygedo.

Content.SourceString: 他觉得鉴定师的提议很有道理，下次就这么干。
Content.LocalizedString: He thinks the Appraiser's suggestion makes a lot of sense, so he'll do that next time.

Content.SourceString: 以及……嗯！塔吉多也最喜欢那张照片。真好。
Content.LocalizedString: And also… oh! Taygedo likes that photo the most too. That's nice.

Content.SourceString: 我刚刚加到了嘭嘭先生的呗果好友，以后就能看到嘭嘭先生分享的墨菲克斯日常生活了。
Content.LocalizedString: I just added Boomboom as a Bagel friend, so now I'll be able to see the daily life posts he shares about Morphix.

Content.SourceString: 稍微有点意外，埃德嘉之前也会加委托人呗果好友吗？
Content.LocalizedString: That's a bit surprising. Does Edgar usually add clients as Bagel friends?

Content.SourceString: 因为很想知道更多墨菲克斯的日常生活……他们相处起来会是什么样子呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Because I really want to learn more about Morphix's daily life… I wonder what it's like when they spend time together?

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉鼓励我说「不妨大胆问人家加好友！不试试看怎么知道！」
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally encouraged me and said, "Why not be bold and ask to add them as friends! You'll never know unless you try!"

Content.SourceString: 然后试了试……嘭嘭先生人很好，发给我很多墨菲克斯的照片呢。
Content.LocalizedString: So I gave it a try… Boomboom is really nice, he sent me lots of photos of Morphix.

Content.SourceString: 在嘭嘭先生眼里，墨菲克斯只是一条普通狗狗吧。
Content.LocalizedString: To Boomboom, Morphix is probably just an ordinary dog.

Content.SourceString: 嗯！那样也没关系。蒲公英的日常生活也很有趣……
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah! That's fine too. Dandelion's daily life is also very interesting…

Content.SourceString: 嘭嘭先生还说他在呗果上记录了很多蒲公英的小趣事。就像写日记一样，每天都记录了很多呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Boomboom also said he's recorded lots of little interesting stories about Dandelion on Bagel. Just like writing a diary, he records so many things every day.

Content.SourceString: 我也有在写异象观察日记，或许可以和嘭嘭先生一起交流一下。
Content.LocalizedString: I've also been keeping an anomaly observation diary. Maybe I could exchange notes with Boomboom.

Content.SourceString: 观察塔吉多吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You mean observing Taygedo?

Content.SourceString: 和塔吉多有关的日记，之前有给塔吉多看过……
Content.LocalizedString: The diary entries about Taygedo… I showed them to Taygedo before…

Content.SourceString: 但塔吉多说我还没见到他最帅气的一面，让我敬请期待。
Content.LocalizedString: But Taygedo said I haven't seen his most handsome side yet, and told me to look forward to it.

Content.SourceString: 那我也开始「期待」。
Content.LocalizedString: Then I guess I'll start looking forward to it too.

Content.SourceString: 最近主要在写纳库佩达的观察日记……只是……
Content.LocalizedString: I've mainly been writing observation notes about Nacupeda lately… It's just…

Content.SourceString: 只是？
Content.LocalizedString: Just what?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多说他吃醋了，他的专属传记作家怎么可以跑去写别的异象。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo said he's jealous. How could his exclusive biographer go off and write about other anomalies?

Content.SourceString: 这就是塔吉多，臭屁自恋獭。
Content.LocalizedString: That's just like Taygedo, the smug little narcissist.

Content.SourceString: 别想太多，就让他酸上一阵吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't overthink it. Just let him be jealous for a while.

Content.SourceString: 如果早些找到「随心泥」的特性，塔吉多的表白是不是就不会失败了呢……
Content.LocalizedString: If we had discovered Imaginadough's properties earlier, wouldn't Taygedo's confession have succeeded…

Content.SourceString: 别太自责，塔吉多也不希望他的朋友伤心难过吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't blame yourself too much. Taygedo wouldn't want his friend to feel sad about this, would he?

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯……嗯嗯……
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm… mhm…

Content.SourceString: 说起来，「随心泥」制品被塑造成有生命的生物形态后，有「活化」的风险——鉴定师是这么认为的对吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Speaking of which, when Imaginadough creations are shaped into living creature forms, there's a risk of them becoming animated, right? That's what the Appraiser believes, isn't it?

Content.SourceString: 是的，是根据在DSD探听到的线索推断……
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, it's based on clues we picked up at DSD…

Content.SourceString: DSD似乎并不承认「随心泥」具有这种属性呢……一口咬定事件原因还在调查中。
Content.LocalizedString: DSD doesn't seem to acknowledge that Imaginadough has this property… They stubbornly insist the cause of the incident is still under investigation.

Content.SourceString: 只是一个推断，不一定是真相。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just a theory. It might not be the truth.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟严格说来，我没能找到奇点……
Content.LocalizedString: After all, strictly speaking, I wasn't able to find the Nexus…

Content.SourceString: 「随心泥」这边找不到奇点也并不奇怪，因为它们是用一种叫「波波力波」的异象身上增生的物质加工制作成的异象商品。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not surprising we can't find a Nexus in the Imaginadough, because it's an anomaly product made by processing material that grows on an anomaly called "Bobbolibbo."

Content.SourceString: 也就是说是「衍生异象」。既然鉴定师那么说，奇点应该在「波波力波」的本体那里吧。
Content.LocalizedString: In other words, it's a "derivative anomaly." Since the Appraiser said that, the Nexus should be on Bobbolibbo itself.

Content.SourceString: 衍生异象是？
Content.LocalizedString: What's a derivative anomaly?

Content.SourceString: 有类似于「波波力波」和「随心泥」这种，异象能力衍生出来的产物关系。
Content.LocalizedString: It's like the relationship between Bobbolibbo and Imaginadough, where products are derived from an anomaly's abilities.

Content.SourceString: 也有类似于亚种、变种等，由原先异象发展而出，改变了形态的情况。
Content.LocalizedString: There are also cases like subspecies and variants that develop from original anomalies and change their form.

Content.SourceString: 真是五花八门啊。
Content.LocalizedString: There's really so many different types.

Content.SourceString: 是啊。关于异象，我们还有好多好多不懂的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah. There's still so much we don't understand about anomalies.

Content.SourceString: 像这样一直探索、一直发现新的知识……真好啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Being able to keep exploring like this, always discovering new knowledge… it's wonderful.

Content.SourceString: 顺带一提，还有件事我稍微有点在意。
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, there's something that's been bothering me a little.

Content.SourceString: 那个……因为想更了解塔可小姐一些，在制定约会计划的时候我搜索了塔可小姐的资料。
Content.LocalizedString: Um… because I wanted to understand Tako better, I looked up her information online when I was planning the date.

Content.SourceString: 但是。嗯……什么都没有找到……
Content.LocalizedString: But… um… I couldn't find anything…

Content.SourceString: 原来可以查到塔可小姐的资料吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So you can actually look up Tako's information online?

Content.SourceString: 啊，是我擅自类比了塔吉多……我想尤克阿什庭应该有收录塔吉多、塔可小姐的异象资料。
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, I was making assumptions about Taygedo… I think Yggash Court should have anomaly records for both Taygedo and Tako.

Content.SourceString: 像塔吉多这样的普通异象市民的相关信息，是可以直接在尤克阿什庭的图书馆中查到的。
Content.LocalizedString: Information about ordinary anomaly citizens like Taygedo can be found directly in Yggash Court's library.

Content.SourceString: 唔……难道说塔可小姐的资料调阅权限其实很高吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… could it be that Tako's records actually require high clearance to access?

Content.SourceString: 又或者是资料中并不是用「塔可」这个名字……
Content.LocalizedString: Or perhaps the records don't use the name Tako…

Content.SourceString: 塔可小姐真是神秘。
Content.LocalizedString: Tako really is mysterious.

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯……嗯嗯……
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm… mhm…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你还记得那天晚上我们聊的「空号」事件吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you remember the "Invalid Number" incident we talked about the other night?

Content.SourceString: 我……我想再和你聊一下，可以吗？呗果上聊就可以……
Content.LocalizedString: I… I was hoping we could discuss it some more. Is that okay? We can just chat on Bagel…

Content.SourceString: 是发生什么事了吗？我在听。
Content.LocalizedString: Did something happen? I'm listening.

Content.SourceString: 我……昨天晚上，我也做了「空号」相关的梦。
Content.LocalizedString: I… I dreamed about an "Invalid Number" last night.

Content.SourceString: 它应该的确是个迷因异象吧？是因为我最近总在想它的事，让我也做了那个，熟悉的人叫我给他打电话的梦么……？
Content.LocalizedString: It's just a Meme Anomaly, right? Could thinking about it so much lately be why I had that dream where someone familiar told me to call them…?

Content.SourceString: 梦中的，是你熟悉的好朋友的声音吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Was it the voice of a close friend?

Content.SourceString: 是的。虽然梦见的是一个朦朦胧胧的身影，但他一开口我就知道了……
Content.LocalizedString: Yes. The figure in the dream was hazy, but the moment he spoke, I knew exactly who it was…

Content.SourceString: 那是我很小很小的时候。有次生病住了十几天的院，我在医院花园里认识了一位老爷爷。
Content.LocalizedString: I was super young, back then. One time, I got sick and spent over ten days in the hospital. That's where I met an old man in the hospital garden.

Content.SourceString: 老爷爷看我年纪很小，主动和我来搭话。我们总是一起晒上一个多小时太阳，聊聊天。然后老爷爷回去打点滴前，会约定好我们明天见。
Content.LocalizedString: The old man noticed how young I was and struck up a conversation. We'd sit in the sun together for over an hour, chatting. Before heading back to his room for his IV, he'd always promise we'd meet again the next day.

Content.SourceString: 老爷爷说，别看他年纪大了，但是个经验很丰富的异象猎人呢。他给我讲了好多好多他处理异象的故事，讲得特别有趣。
Content.LocalizedString: The old man said that even though he was pretty old, he was a very experienced Anomaly Hunter. He told me so many stories about the Anomalies he'd dealt with, and they were always really fun to listen to.

Content.SourceString: 我觉得，爷爷只把故事讲给我听太可惜了。要是能写下来，发表出来，就有更多的小朋友可以读到其中的故事了。
Content.LocalizedString: I felt it was a shame that he only told his stories to me. If he wrote them down and published them, more children would've been able to read them.

Content.SourceString: 爷爷似乎很开心的样子，说我给他出了个好主意。他接下来决定以童书作家为目标努力写作，当然在那之前，要先战胜生的这场重病才行。
Content.LocalizedString: The old man seemed delighted, saying I'd given him a great idea. He then decided to work toward becoming a children's-book author. Of course, he first had to overcome the serious illness he was battling.

Content.SourceString: 现在有了新的目标，所以爷爷就更有干劲，更觉得自己能早点出院了。
Content.LocalizedString: Having a new goal made him even more motivated, and he felt sure he could get out of the hospital sooner.

Content.SourceString: 只是……有个故事我没能听爷爷讲完。那天他讲着讲着，突然咳嗽得很厉害。医生很快就赶过来，把爷爷推走了。
Content.LocalizedString: But… there was one story I never got to hear him finish. That day, while he was telling it, he suddenly started coughing violently. The doctors all rushed over and wheeled him away.

Content.SourceString: 在那之后没多久，我就康复出院了。所以，我再也没见到过爷爷，也没听到过故事的结局。
Content.LocalizedString: Not long after that, I recovered and was discharged from the hospital. I never saw him again, nor did I ever hear how the story ended.

Content.SourceString: 但因为和爷爷约定过，我相信，我有一天一定能看到那个完整的故事。
Content.LocalizedString: I made a promise to him. I believe that, someday, I'll get to see the whole story.

Content.SourceString: 所以……
Content.LocalizedString: So…

Content.SourceString: 所以，梦里的爷爷打来电话说。因为他不知道我的号码，希望我能根据这个号码，主动打电话给他。
Content.LocalizedString: So, in the dream, that old man called and told me that, because he didn't know my number, he wanted me to call him at the number he gave me in the dream.

Content.SourceString: 这样，爷爷就能把那个没能讲完的故事讲给我听了。
Content.LocalizedString: That way, he could tell me the rest of the story he never got to finish.

Content.SourceString: 但你知道这只是梦，或者说，只是迷因异象「空号」营造出来的……
Content.LocalizedString: But you know it was just a dream—or, rather, something the Meme Anomaly "Invalid Number" created…

Content.SourceString: 嗯……但不止这样。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… but it's more than that.

Content.SourceString: 我，我是不会给那个号码回电的。
Content.LocalizedString: I… I'm not calling that number back.

Content.SourceString: 因为很早以前，我就擅自在心里和爷爷约定过。我要在他出版的故事书里读到那个故事的结局。
Content.LocalizedString: Because long ago, I'd made a promise to him in my heart. I'd read the ending of that story in a book he would publish someday.

Content.SourceString: 我明明……早就这么想好了才是。可是为什么……
Content.LocalizedString: I was sure… I'd made up my mind about this a long time ago. But why…

Content.SourceString: 为什么我现在还是忍不住坐在了电话旁，打开了电话簿呢……奇怪……
Content.LocalizedString: Why am I sitting by the phone now, unable to stop myself from opening the phonebook? It's odd…

Content.SourceString: 明明……我很坚定地认为我，绝对不会打那个电话的……但为什么……忍不住有这个念头……
Content.LocalizedString: I was so sure… I really believed I'd never make that call. But why, then… why can't I stop thinking about it…?

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉，想哭的话，就哭出来吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar, if you feel like crying, go ahead.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢……谢谢你，鉴定师……
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you… Thank you, Appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师。我感觉现在好多了。
Content.LocalizedString: I appreciate it, Appraiser. I feel a lot better now.

Content.SourceString: 没想到自己能亲自遭遇「空号」这个异象，做那个大家都心心念念，怎么都放不下的梦。
Content.LocalizedString: I never thought I'd encounter the "Invalid Number" Anomaly firsthand and have such an unforgettable dream. It was unlike anything I'd ever experienced before.

Content.SourceString: 其实爷爷，很可能已经不在人世了吧？毕竟，距离我认识爷爷，也过去好几年了。
Content.LocalizedString: He's probably gone by now, isn't he? After all, it's been years since i met him.

Content.SourceString: 但我愿意相信，他可能正在哪个花园里开心地锄着杂草，和花丛里的小布妮打招呼。晒够太阳后，就回到桌前继续写故事。
Content.LocalizedString: But I want to believe he might be somewhere in that garden, happily pulling weeds and waving to the Little Buni among the flowers. Once he had his fill of sunshine, he'd go back to his desk and continue writing stories.

Content.SourceString: 说不定未来的某一天，我能在书店中读到那个故事的后续……
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe one day, I'll find the rest of that story in a bookstore…

Content.SourceString: 我，想这么去相信。
Content.LocalizedString: I… want to believe that.

Content.SourceString: 所以……不见面，不打那通电话，也没关系的。
Content.LocalizedString: So… it's okay if we don't meet, and if I don't make that phone call at all.

Content.SourceString: 因为我会一直记得和爷爷一起晒太阳，听故事的那段时光。只要它有过，存在过，我始终珍惜着……那样就好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Because I'll always remember those days, sitting in the sun with him and listening to his stories. The fact that those memories happened at all—that they were real… I'll always treasure that. That's enough.

Content.SourceString: 而且……正是因为……未来很可能会见不到面。
Content.LocalizedString: And… it's also because… we may very well not see each other again.

Content.SourceString: 才要更好好地去珍惜，现在在一起的时光嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: That's why we should treasure the time we have together now more than ever.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，伊波恩的大家，还有好多好多朋友们……
Content.LocalizedString: You, everyone in Eibon, and many, many other friends…

Content.SourceString: 能认识你们，真是太好了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm so glad I got to meet you all.
